$about: Capability -> paths, so the coupling guard can bind a spec to what it describes (R11). Derived from this repository's real layout. NOTE for anyone editing: this repository's product is decisions and reference files rather than a running service, so a capability owns documents and a shipped tree, not a slice of application code. The Layer 1 files this repository carries as an adopter (scripts/, .claude/, specs/, docs/, the two manifests) are $unclaimed on purpose: they are the standard's own content, governed by the core's specs, and claiming them here would make every core update read as a change to a capability of this repository.
